eventDetail.scope: 2026 the International Conference on Computational Science and Power Engineering (CSPE) will be take place in Hefei, Anhui, China during November 13th-15th, 2026. It is sponsored by Hefei University of Technology, China; hosted by School of Electrical Engineering and Automation of Hefei University of Technology, China. The conference focuses on the application and innovation of computational science and technology in power engineering. CSPE2026 aims to foster collaboration among researchers and practitioners focused on the intersection of computational science and power engineering. Attendees will have the opportunity to share and discuss innovative ideas, emerging trends, and significant challenges within this field. The topics suggested by this conference can be discussed in term of concepts, surveys, state of the art, research, standards, implementations, running experiments, applications and industrial case studies.
